newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on Tuesday, as the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar stimulated moderate short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 1.3 yen per kg higher. Benchmark December was up 1.3 yen at 113.3 yen.
The market started the day on a firmer tone amid caution that prices were too low after recent price falls, they said.

Although there were expectations that China may buy some rubber from producing countries, traders say, the upside potential in rubber futures would be still limited on rising rubber output in those countries, they said.
